project.description: Overrides the project name, which otherwise comes from the git common dir.

defaultApp.description: Which app `simwt up` uses with no argument.

runtime.description: Runtime pin as "version" or "version/build". Pin the build when two Ready runtimes share a version.

warmOnCreate.description: Apps the worktree setup hook installs from the build cache.

dir.description: Path to the Expo app, relative to the repo root.

templateApps.description: Apps the template carries. Defaults to every declared app. Trim it to keep an app you rarely run out of every clone.
